patterns.note: The site uses a combination of full-width sections with centered content and two-column layouts, often featuring a prominent 'app UI' card on one side.
Key headings and call-to-action text consistently use a custom pixelated font, creating a distinctive retro-digital aesthetic, while body text uses a clean, modern sans-serif.
A soft, light blue serves as the primary background color, contrasted with a vibrant orange for accents and calls-to-action, and a dark brown for pixel art ground elements.

A pixel art robot character acts as a sticky element, initially positioned within the hero, then scrolling up with the content to eventually 'land' on a pixel art ground section that reveals from the bottom of the viewport.
Pixel art cloud elements are fixed in the background, creating a subtle parallax effect as the page content scrolls over them.
Interactive accordion elements are used for the FAQ section, providing a clean way to present detailed information without overwhelming the user.

technique_notes: The pixelated font effect for headings is achieved by using a custom web font designed with a pixel grid, likely rendered with CSS text-rendering properties to maintain crispness.

The pixel art character's scroll behavior is implemented using a combination of CSS position: sticky and JavaScript to dynamically adjust its vertical position and alignment with the pixel art ground as the user scrolls, creating a 'landing' animation.
Background pixel art elements (clouds) are fixed in the viewport using CSS position: fixed, allowing content to scroll over them and create a sense of depth.

design_tokens.type_scale: Oversized pixelated hero headings (~4-5x body) with smaller pixelated subheadings, complemented by a clean, readable sans-serif for body text and UI elements.
design_tokens.radius: Subtle rounding (small border-radius) is applied consistently to buttons, cards, and input fields, avoiding sharp corners or full pills.
design_tokens.spacing: Generally airy, with generous vertical spacing between major sections and ample padding within content blocks, creating a balanced and uncluttered feel.

standout: The site's most distinctive feature is its pervasive pixel art aesthetic, which is integrated through a custom pixelated font for headings, animated pixel art characters, and background elements. This creates a unique, playful, and memorable brand identity that stands out from typical modern marketing sites.
